newsitem.title: CHINA: China Agriculture Bank sees rapid deposits growth.
newsitem.headline: China Agriculture Bank sees rapid deposits growth.

text.p: The Agricultural Bank of China saw remarkable growth in deposits and loans this year and attributed the increase to moves toward commercialisation and better service, the Xinhua news agency said on Sunday.
By the end of November, the bank had 877.28 billion yuan in deposits, up by 20 percent compared with the end of 1995, it said quoting bank sources.
It had extended 762.99 billion yuan in loans, a rise of 14 percent respectively from the end of last year, it said.
One of China's four big state-owned commercial banks, the agricultural bank has boosted assistance to cash-strapped state-owned enterprises this year in line with government policy, it said.
It has also studied advanced technology and financial management and operations at overseas banks, it said.
The bank has started to support border trade with neighboring countries by signing mutual clearance agreements to promote businesses, Xinhua said.
The recent introduction of the bank's computerised clearance system was seen as a big step forward, it said.
